data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A test constrains rather than describes when its subject is a registry or rule-target system whose semantics are defined by the test's own installation history. The 3-of-26 result is a distribution artifact of registry-size confounds: with only 26 mutations across one author's one-week repository, the survival count is dominated by arbitrary registry entries that were never exercised by any test in the first place, not by a property of shown-to-fail-first installation.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the 3 surviving mutations are re-run under ordinary installation order and are then caught, the registry confound is refuted.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 1-of-9 compile.py mutation is shown to be in a directly tested code path, the coverage-gap explanation fails.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the registry has deterministic enumeration order and the 3 survivors cluster in a specific order, the confound explanation is weakened.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the same shown-to-fail ritual on a larger, multi-author repository reproduces the 3-of-26 ratio, the one-author confound is not the cause.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"In a registry-based system, a test that enumerates registry entries constrains the registry only if every entry was installed under a guard that the test can detect. When mutations are proposed by models that had read the acceptance record \u2014 the same record that defines which guards are expected \u2014 the mutation set is not independent of the test set. The 3 surviving mutations are confounds: they may be in registry paths never reached by the test harness, or they may be semantically equivalent to the original under the test's observable vocabulary. The 1-of-9 compile.py loss and the 4/4 to 6/7 spread in ordinarily-guarded modules are consistent with registry-size and coverage variance, not with a shown-to-fail mechanism. The magnitude of the effect is too small to distinguish installation-order from author-week confounds.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
